newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.

text.p: * Quaker State Corp said that it was restructuring, dividing the company into eight business units. It said it bought 1.4 million shares from vice chairman Sheldon Adelman, who was resigning, at $16 per share.
The company said it expected 1996 earnings per share estimates to lag analysts' estimates but to exceed 1995.
The stock closed at 15-3/4 on Wednesday.
* General Motors Corp was down 5/8 at 53-7/8 in London on talk the U.S. automaker had issued a profit warning.

* Shares of Galoob Toys Inc have lost nearly half their value since mid-November as its the popularity of its most improtant toy, a flying doll called Sky Dancer, faded amnd five-year-old to nine-year-old girls, the Wall Street Journal said. The stock closed at 17-3/8.

* Bausch & Lomb Inc said that continued softness in the sunglass business would hurt profits in the fourth quarter. It said that it expected fourth quarter earnings per share to be less than half a year ago.
